definitions.gloss: freshly fried; just out of the fryer
definitions.explanation: food that has just been deep-fried and is still hot and crispy

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{立|た}ての{天|てん}ぷらは{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: Freshly fried tempura is the best.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{立|た}ての{唐揚|からあ}げをどうぞ。
このコロッケは{揚|あ}げ{立|た}てなので、{中|なか}が{熱|あつ}いですよ。
examples.english: This croquette is fresh from the fryer, so the inside is hot.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{揚|あ}げる (to deep-fry) + {立|た}て (just done)

PATTERN:
The ~{立|た}て pattern indicates something freshly done:
- {焼|や}き{立|た}て - freshly baked
- {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て - freshly boiled
- {出来立|できた}て - freshly made
- {採|と}れ{立|た}て - freshly picked

USAGE:
- Often used in food service to emphasize quality
- Used as a no-adjective: {揚|あ}げ{立|た}ての{天|てん}ぷら

RELATED:
- サクサク - crispy (onomatopoeia)
- {揚|あ}げ{物|もの} - fried food
- {油|あぶら} - oil
